source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 1368 dark-mode repair gives message buttons a dark foreground and security buttons a light foreground instead of inheriting a single mode-dependent value. The accepted stylesheet keeps the same type distinction through gray-90 and gray-05 tokens. In this notification family, recommend selecting foreground together with the type-specific background; changing every button foreground with the page mode can undo that distinction. This is a scoped CSS recommendation, not proof of sufficient contrast. No computed color, contrast, keyboard or visual check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Message and security notification buttons retain type-specific foreground colors
